meta: Learn a new skill in 15 minutes a day with AI, for people with no free time. Day 6 of the 7-day AI challenge.

muc.title: Day 6: learning a new skill
muc.text: Day six of seven: no time to learn something new? Fifteen minutes a day with AI is enough to start.

muc.title: Pick a tiny skill
muc.text: Choose a really small skill, like cooking three vegetarian dishes, and tell AI your current level.

muc.title: A plan of seven mini sessions
muc.text: Ask AI to split it into seven 15-minute sessions, each with something to do, not just something to read.

muc.title: Let AI test you at the end
muc.text: In the last session, ask AI for five questions and have it grade you. Review whatever you got wrong.

muc.title: Day 6 task
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for a seven-session plan for the skill you chose, and do the first session tonight.
